resources.string: Your AI assistant can use OsmAnd · %1$s
Lets an AI assistant on your computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) use OsmAnd on this phone: show places, plan routes, start navigation.
Works with the phone locked. A notification shows while the connector is on.

resources.string: The model runs on this phone: after the download it needs no internet and nothing leaves the phone. Bigger models answer better but slower and need more memory.
Google\'s model built into the phone (Android AICore). Nothing to download in this app. Only on supported phones, such as Pixel 9 and newer.
Qwen3 1.7B on the phone\'s GPU, 1 GB. Smaller download, but in multi-step requests it often stops halfway or guesses settings.
Google Gemma 4 E2B on the phone\'s GPU, 2.3 GB. The best in our tests: 18 of 20 commands and 6 of 7 multi-step requests right. It finds map style settings and can look at the OsmAnd screen.
The phone can download it (Android AICore)
Ready · runs on this phone, offline
